name: repo-surveyor
description: A repo-agnostic survey plugin: three staff-level lenses that scout a codebase and emit evidence-cited findings reports, inventing nothing. debt-radar digs technical debt (code smells, dead code, swallowed/silenced errors) with a severity, a T-shirt LOE, benefit, and an explicit do-vs-not trade-off per finding, and can verify whether a past finding is now resolved. feature-gap maps the reachable user-facing surface (UI routes, MCP tool schemas, CLI, public/exported API) for gaps, inconsistencies, low discoverability, recommended features, and the product metrics worth tracking. signal-map recommends surgical log/metric/trace placement at hot paths and error branches for debugging and feature-performance. Read-only by default; every finding cites a path:line, symbol, or commit.
